known_gaps: Provider request and response JSON schemas have not been verified; every shape above is illustrative.
No production or test transport interface presently maps a thread summary to threadId, optional subject, and lastMessageAt UTC.
The legacy MailBackend uses message-oriented summaries with sender, preview, and attachment fields, has no pagination or lastMessageAt, and also exposes write-capable operations.
The Hub client cursor format and binding are intentionally unspecified here; provider page tokens are not client cursors.
No existing proof establishes provider account binding, version/definition pinning, or that opening a thread leaves it unread.
